[[Maeko]] crafts armor for core professions using the [[Ascalon armor]] art and Factions professions using the [[Seitung armor]] art. Maeko also crafts the [[Prophecies]] versions of [[Ranger masks]], [[Monk scalp designs]], [[Necromancer scar patterns]] and [[Mesmer masks]], as well as [[Elementalist headgear#Factions headgear art|Elementalist auras]]. All armor is crafted with a blank [[insignia slot]].
